title: Kissed Crisp Tunisian Chicken Kebabs
description: A fresh and crisp Tunisian dish featuring jerk seasoning and render fat, perfect for a low calorie friendly meal, this recipe is a flavorful and festive twist on traditional chicken kebabs.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together jerk seasoning, render fat, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Let the kebabs rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as couscous or roasted vegetables.
